newsitem.title: USA: KTI sets venture with Pine Tree Waste.
newsitem.headline: KTI sets venture with Pine Tree Waste.

text.p: KTI Inc said Friday it signed an agreement with Pine Tree Waste Inc to form a waste brokerage venture, Specialties Environmental Management Co LLC, which will be 55 percent owned by KTI.
The principals of Portland, Maine, based Pine Tree have been in the waste brokerage, handling and disposal business for over 25 years.

Specialties Environmental will be a brokerage agency for a broad range of incoming municipal solid and specialty waste products which will be disposed of at KTI facilities, the company said. It receives $80 to $150 per ton as a disposal fee for specialty waste delivered to its facilities. KTI's current average disposal fee for municipal solid waste is about $37 per ton, it noted.
